items.label: High-Speed & High-Fidelity Transmission
items.value: Built with additional shielding to reduce signal interference, this Cat8 Ethernet cable is designed for stable, high-fidelity data transmission. Made of 4 shielded foiled twisted pairs (F/FTP) and 26AWG single-strand oxygen-free copper wires, it supports bandwidth up to 2000 MHz and data transmission speeds up to 40 Gbps, suitable for low-latency gaming, 4K/8K streaming, and high-speed internet connections.

items.label: 26AWG & Stable Performance
items.value: Compared with thinner 32AWG cables, this 26AWG Cat8 Ethernet cable features a thicker conductor for more stable and reliable data transfer. Designed to support high-speed networks, it is suitable for AI smart devices such as Amazon Alexa, Apple Siri, Google Home, and cloud data servers.

items.label: Weatherproof & UV Resistant
items.value: Designed with a UV-resistant PVC jacket, this outdoor-rated Cat8 Ethernet cable can withstand direct sunlight, extreme cold, humidity, and hot weather. The anti-aging construction helps maintain consistent network performance for long-term outdoor and indoor use. Includes 18-month support and long-term customer service.

items.label: Shielded RJ45 & Wide Compatibility
items.value: Equipped with two shielded RJ45 connectors, this Cat8 Ethernet cable is compatible with networking switches, routers, modems, IP cameras, gaming consoles (PS3, PS4, Xbox), patch panels, servers, smart TVs, and more. Fully backward compatible with Cat7, Cat6, Cat5e, and Cat5 devices.
